name: Chapter Route - New York City on phone and tablet
description: The founding chapter with NO events tagged to it, at phone and tablet widths — the small-screen half of 'Chapter Route - New York City' (split in two because the NYC photo gallery makes all four sizes in one capture exceed the capture tool's per-scenario time limit). Neither an upcoming nor a recent events block renders; the capped photo gallery and its 'Show all' control fit the narrow grid.
